title: Treat findings and runbooks as private-only in migration
context: hunch private --migrate moves memory records to an overlay and gitignores each record type in the public repo. Runbooks and findings were missing from this list, causing them to leak into published repos when they should remain private. Touches invariant(s): con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file).
decision: Added runbooks/ and findings/ to MEM_ENTRIES constant so they're automatically gitignored during private migration, matching the treatment of symbols/ and edges/.
consequences: Private records no longer leak to public repo on migration
Establishes pattern: all private record types must be explicitly listed in MEM_ENTRIES
Also whitelisted findings/ in this repo's own curated gitignore for consistency
alternatives_rejected: Manual .gitignore entries only (wouldn't auto-apply during migration process)
Fixing only one record type (both need same privacy guarantee)
